items.title: EU to Support Libya in the Fight Against Terrorism and for Border Security
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The European Union’s ambassador to Libya, Nicola Orlando, met yesterday in Tripoli with members of the 3+3 Joint Military Committee, which brings together representatives from Tripoli and Benghazi under the auspices of the Ministry of Defense and the General Command of the Libyan Arab Armed Forces. items.title: The first Senegalese selected for the “New Destinies” project visited the embassy
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Dakar, Michele Tommasi, welcomed the first twelve Senegalese workers who will soon take part in the “New Destinies – New Horizons” project in Italy, in the presence of representatives from institutions, training organizations, and partners involved in the initiative. items.title: Kenya: Murkomen Warns Against Illegal Use of Police Military, Style Uniforms
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen has directed Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja to move with speed against individuals wearing camouflage and other security-style uniforms while allegedly posing as police officers or members of specialised security units.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Murkomen Warns Against Illegal Use of Police Military, Style Uniforms

items.title: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to the Republic of Kenya and the Seychelles, Vincenzo Del Monaco, met with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya, Kamau Thugge, with whom he had “an important exchange of information.” “It was an opportunity to discuss the country’s economic situation,” the embassy noted, “and the growing bilateral relationship between Italy and Kenya.” Read article...
items.titleIt: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya

items.title: Centemero, 'porterò all'Onu candidatura di Milano come hub per governance etica IA'
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - "L'Italia ha davanti un'opportunità strategica: non limitarsi a partecipare al dibattito sull'intelligenza artificiale, ma contribuire a costruirne la futura governance globale. Il policy paper dell'American Chamber of Commerce in Italy e il successivo intervento del managing director Simone Crolla indicano una strada concreta: candidare Milano a ospitare una futura piattaforma o organismo delle Nazioni Unite dedicato alla governance etica dell'intelligenza artificiale. È una proposta che condivido pienamente". Lo afferma il deputato della Lega Giulio Centemero, preside
items.titleIt: Centemero, 'porterò all'Onu candidatura di Milano come hub per governance etica IA'

items.title: Malawi: MMC Publishing Offers Malawi Solution for Royalty Transparency Amid Cosoma Storm
items.description: [Nyasa Times] The country's pioneer music listening and monitoring digital platform, Malawi-Music.com (MMC), has offered to support the Copyright Society of Malawi (COSOMA) and the country's musicians in resolving royalty-sharing disputes stemming from a lack of proper monitoring.
items.titleIt: Malawi: MMC Publishing Offers Malawi Solution for Royalty Transparency Amid Cosoma Storm

items.title: Tanzania: Uganda, Tanzania Seal Deal to Develop Tanga Into Regional Energy Hub
items.description: [Independent (Kampala)] Dar es Salaam -- President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni of Uganda and Samia Suluhu Hassan of Tanzania have endorsed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at reshaping East Africa's energy economy by shifting the region's focus from crude oil exports to building an integrated regional energy and industrial hub.
items.titleIt: Tanzania: Uganda, Tanzania Seal Deal to Develop Tanga Into Regional Energy Hub

items.title: Women in El-Obeid testify to rape during Sudan conflict
items.description: Displaced women living in a camp in El-Obeid, in North Kordofan, say they were raped by Rapid Support Forces (RSF) members in front of their children before fleeing.
items.titleIt: Women in El-Obeid testify to rape during Sudan conflict

items.title: An Alliance for Vocational Training in Mozambique with Italy’s Support
items.description: (ANSA) - MAPUTO, 06 AGO - Mozambique’s Minister of Youth and Sports, Caifadine Paulo Manasse, opened the workshop “Alliance for the Future: Co-Investing in Training, Nurturing Talent," in Maputo Province on Thursday, August 6, calling for a new strategic partnership between the government, industry, and development partners, with the goal of transforming vocational training into a driver of industrialization and job creation.
